stock.description: Feiyu Technology International Company Ltd., an investment holding firm, focuses on the development, operation, and distribution of games across mobile, web, and personal computer platforms within Mainland China. Its extensive game portfolio includes notable titles such as Shen Xian Dao, Carrot Fantasy, San Guo Zhi Ren, Jiong Xi You, Da Hua Shen Xian, Ba Qin, and BATTERY RUN. As of December 31, 2021, the company had accumulated approximately 229.1 million registered users, comprising 173.0 million web game users and 56.1 million mobile game users. Additionally, its casual games recorded 635.9 million cumulative activated downloads, while HTML5 games garnered 37.4 million cumulative registered users. Founded in 2009, the company's main office is situated in Xiamen, People's Republic of China.
